question: Each of J, K, L, M, N, O and P has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only two people have exams before P. Only one person has an exam after L. Only three people have exams between P and J. Only one person has an exam between K and L. O has an exam immediately after M. How many people have exams between M and N?
solution:
Let's arrange the exam schedule based on the given clues:

There are 7 people (J, K, L, M, N, O, P) and 7 days (Monday to Sunday).

**1. Only two people have exams before P.**

This means P has the exam on the 3rd day. So, P is on Wednesday.
